Findings and vetoes are empty. missing_evidence: Trigger relevance remains 2/4. The v2 brief retains a plausible recent-conversation task but no concrete active-search count, decision deadline or competing task. The same unconfirmed Friday scenario is useful for continuity but is not a realistic urgency/attention study. Add one interrupted recruiter search task with an explicit commitment before claiming complete operational fit. This is a research/test gap, not a demonstrated product failure.

Field-value hypothesis remains open: no recruiter observation establishes lower effort than copying a note/manual contact entry, reliable detection of seeded identity/purpose errors, fewer missed commitments, or improved outcomes. A moderated comparison should measure source checking, correction burden, total task time and return-to-task accuracy. No score of 4 or field-usefulness claim is awarded.

The authenticated native proof uses one Simulator and a loopback simulated-login/keychain bridge. It does not exercise two actual phones, next-day return, changed external contact state, or physical-device VoiceOver. The deletion test previews and cancels; it does not itself demonstrate actual multi-device deletion. These are scope limits, not evidence that sync/deletion fails.

The fork label is directly visible and accessible after the native edge-back journey, but the exact v1 proposed verification with different subsequent messages in both branches and a later restart was not performed in that UI test. Existing persisted origin identity supports the correction; cross-day retrieval effectiveness is still inferred.

The unreattachable-original-images case from v1 remains untested. The existing recovery gate preserves the original task and avoids text replay; this packet does not infer that removing the gate is safe.

Production parity, deployment, TestFlight distribution and physical-device proof remain with root and are not asserted here.

Assertions are at /tmp/get5-product-review-v3/source/apps/ios/UITests/CandidateSignalUITests.swift:5061-5111; the execution records the reconciled receipt at /tmp/get5-product-review-v3/evidence/get5-ios-ui-pending-footer-r8.log:460 and People detail at :590. missing_evidence: Confidence remains supported_inference: this reviewer inspected frozen pixels, implementation and execution logs rather than directly operating the build. The new footer evidence covers English/light portrait Simulator behavior, not actual physical-device VoiceOver speech or traversal. A full release approval still requires its own direct-interaction evidence.

The v2 limits remain: AX5 Markdown table/code proof on iPhone17Pro and SE3 does not establish the full contact-review/save/recovery path at AX5; Chinese AX5 fork selection after relaunch, horizontal code traversal/Copy code activation, permission denial/revocation, the native share-sheet payload, oldest-supported-iOS behavior, real-device performance and a two-phone field exercise are not newly tested by this footer correction.

The failed authenticated startup in /tmp/get5-product-review-v3/evidence/get5-ios-ui-pending-footer-r7.log:307-309 remains a failed run. The passing r8 is a dedicated targeted case, not proof that all native cases passed in one combined suite. Test duration is not an interaction-latency measurement.

The final incremental Release build, backend deployment and any TestFlight/App Store Connect distribution are root-owned and are not established by this v3 packet. Earlier v2 Release Simulator evidence remains historical proof of that earlier build only.

Its footer describes checking or retrying the original operation, with a recovery icon and combined accessibility label.
